processDependencyCompleteness.rationale: All four audited chains are recoverable across the candidate statements: resource/identity/track/user/need/content; self-relative update rhythm; good content before paid amplification; and ad-supported monetization requiring insertable situations. The relation array is semantically weak, but the dependency content itself is present.

unguardedRelationships: The probe/protocol reduces the resource × user demand × platform preference constraint on content choice to generic precedes_and_frames chronology.
The identity + track -> target user -> user needs dependency is not independently guarded as a semantic relation.
The conditions linking content quality to account-warming/paid amplification, and insertable situations to ad monetization, are not guarded as typed semantic relations.
metaAudit.rationale: All available carriers were inspected, but the relationship discovery protocol is chronology-dominant. Multiple audit-critical causal, constraint, and conditional relations therefore remain outside the protocol's explicit checks. Candidate prose containing some of those relations cannot prove that the protocol guarded them.
